integrity: The proof is an analytic branchwise reconstruction of the published Green-operator estimates. No numerical experiment or external certificate is used as proof.
limitations: Sufficient conditions only; no optimality is claimed. The inverse exponent uses the full perturbation bound epsilon_s+epsilon_u and may be conservative. The theorem is restricted to the classical trivial-bundle nonautonomous setting; no abstract-bundle extension is claimed. The full text of the 2011 Barreira–Valls flow paper was not available in the bounded lawful-source search, leaving a residual equivalence risk.
title: Anisotropic projected Hölder budgets for nonautonomous Hartman–Grobman conjugacies
